name: dotnet-channels

Guide to `System.Threading.Channels`: thread-safe producer/consumer queues, bounded/unbounded channels, backpressure, `IAsyncEnumerable`, graceful shutdown, hosted services.

`Channel<T>` has separate `ChannelWriter<T>` and `ChannelReader<T>`. Bounded channels are preferred for production; unbounded channels can exhaust memory under load. Unbounded -- use only when you control the producer rate.

`FullMode`: `Wait`, `DropOldest`, `DropNewest`, `DropWrite`. Use `TryWrite` for non-blocking overflow detection. Call `Complete()` or `TryComplete()` when no more items will be produced. Use `ReadAllAsync()` or the `WaitToReadAsync`/`TryRead` drain pattern. Multiple consumers scale processing; each item is read by exactly one consumer.

`SingleReader = true` or `SingleWriter = true` enables lock-free optim
